title: pm-dispatch(contract-review): the lane reviews its own PRs; triage takes only a review nobody is doing, and one claim line per head keeps two reviewers off the same head
body:
Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). Filed by the triage seat (`session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`), 2026-10-28 ~03:15Z. It amends #26667 (closed; landed as items 1–7 of `references/contract-review.md` and the triage duties). ⛔ Not a claim.

## The maintainer's words (verbatim, in order)

1. 2026-10-28 00:3xZ, after triage reported PR #26766 as having waited 9 h for a contract review: 「契约复审 不是你应该你负责吗」
2. ~03:10Z: 「应该车车道没有人审查的你才负责契约复审对吧」, i.e. triage owns the review only where the lane has nobody reviewing.
3. ~03:12Z: 「如何避免重复审查」

## Why

- Under #26667 today, triage reviews **only** on a `Contract-review-handoff:` line (the dispatching seat's Fable was quota-refused). PR #26766 (Tier H, ADR-0087) waited from 15:10Z to 00:53Z with no record and no hand-off line. Nobody reviewed it, and its blocked follow-on #26365 waited too.
- After ruling 1, triage reviewed seven heads overnight (#26739 ×4, #26766 ×2, #26831, #27005, #27018, #27034). Some of those (#27005, #27018, #27034) were under an hour old, so the lane may have been about to review them itself. Nothing duplicated. A record-per-head scan shows one record per head on all six PRs. But nothing in the rules prevents a duplicate.

## Wanted

1. **The lane reviews its own** (unchanged: 「谁跑 = 派发席」).
2. **Triage takes a review only when nobody is doing it.** That is, the PR is ready (not draft), it owes a review (`reviewFace` hits ≠ ∅), there is **no record and no live claim on the current head**, and one of these holds:
   - (a) a `Contract-review-handoff:` line names the current head (today's rule);
   - (b) the head has been ready for **at least one full triage round (about 60 min)** with no record and no claim;
   - (c) the PR's lane seat has stood down, or is absent from the seat roster.
3. **One claim line per head prevents duplicates.** Whoever starts a review, lane or triage, first posts one PR comment in a fixed, machine-findable shape:
   `Contract-review-claim: <session> · head <full sha> · <UTC>`
   - Before starting, every reviewer reads the PR. A record or a live claim on the current head means do not start.
   - A claim lapses when the head moves, or 2 h after it was posted with no record on that head (the reviewer died). After that, the next reviewer may claim.
   - **The lane wins a tie:** if a lane claim and a triage claim name the same head, triage withdraws by replying once, and its subagent's work is discarded.
   - Delta re-reviews stay with the reviewer who rendered the record on the earlier head (the existing rule 「只落发现的 commit 由同一复核者 delta 复核」). That is how triage re-reviews its own FAILs, and how a lane re-reviews its own.
4. **The recogniser** (`scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`) parses the claim line (session, head, time) beside the record's `Head-sha` / `Reviewed-by`, so the check is one read. ⛔ No gate reads it. It is coordination, not a merge condition.
5. **The round record** keeps the review table (record head → current head → state), and names who claimed each head.

## Surface

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` (L21–22, the hand-off lines) and the triage duties that list this round step. Tier S. The files are near their line ceilings, so prefer same-line edits or carry a measured ceiling change.
- `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`, plus its tests (the claim parser).
- One PR. `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Acceptance

- A lane seat and triage reading the same PR at the same time cannot both start a review of one head; the second sees the claim.
- A PR that is ready and owes a review is reviewed within two triage rounds, by its lane or by triage.

Dedupe: open `domain:skills` issues read for `contract-review`, `handoff`, `claim`: only #26667 (closed). **New.**
